name: Montana
agency: Montana Department of Revenue, Cannabis and Alcohol Regulation Division (CARD, formerly Alcoholic Beverage Control Division)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: 12-digit licence number: digits 1-2 county, 3-5 city/ZIP/resort area, 6-9 ID, last 3 = licence code (see revenue.mt.gov/card/alcoholic-beverages/licenses/codes). On-premise: all-beverage licences (quota) and on-premises beer & wine (e.g. code 301); 103/203 are off-premises beer/wine.
licence_data.terms_notes: No bulk licensee download seen; only a 'Montana License Lookup' and a quota-sheet PDF (counts by county, not licensees).

local_control: State issues licences; quota by city/county population. Local governing body may object but does not issue.
alternatives: Public records request to Dept of Revenue CARD for full licensee list
Quota sheet PDF (counts only) https://revenuefiles.mt.gov/files/ABCD/quota-sheet.pdf
County health dept food establishment lists
Google Places category search (bar/restaurant) as fallback
manual_steps: Email/call CARD licensing (406-444-6900) or file a public records request asking for an export of all active retail alcoholic beverage licences with licence number, DBA, address
Alternatively scrape the License Lookup at revenue.mt.gov/licenses (check terms)
notes: Control state: state is spirits wholesaler; retail spirits via agency liquor stores. All-beverage licences are scarce quota licences (high-value), so bars are well defined. Many tribal reservations have their own rules.

name: Nebraska

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Retail licence classes by letter: A (beer on-sale), C (beer/wine/spirits on & off sale), I (beer/wine/spirits on-sale only) are the main on-premise classes; D/B are off-sale. Verify class list on NLCC site.
licence_data.cost: fee ($40 for Excel Active License Roster emailed)
licence_data.terms_notes: Free HTML Active License Holder list and license search also exist.

local_control: State issues; city/village/county governing body must recommend approval of each application.
alternatives: Free HTML Active License Holder page https://www.nebraska.gov/nlcc/active/active.cgi (scrapable)
License search https://www.nebraska.gov/nlcc/license_search/licsearch.cgi
POSSE public portal https://posse-lcc.nebraska.gov/prod/webui/
manual_steps: Order the Active License Roster in Excel ($40) from NLCC (P.O. Box 95046, Lincoln NE 68509; pay via PayPort) and re-order periodically
OR scrape the free active.cgi Active License Holder listing on a schedule (verify it lists all rows)
notes: Free HTML list may allow a scheduled scrape, making this near-full automation. No geocoding.

sources.title: Where can I find a list of all liquor licenses in Nebraska?

name: Nevada
agency: No state retail licensing agency; Nevada Department of Taxation licenses importers/wholesalers only. Retail liquor licences issued by counties/cities (e.g. Clark County Dept of Business License, City of Las Vegas, Washoe County, City of Reno)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Clark County liquor categories under code Ch. 8.20 (e.g. tavern, restaurant service bar, on-sale); category list PDF on clarkcountynv.gov. Differs per jurisdiction.
licence_data.terms_notes: No statewide list. Clark County has a Business License Search (by category/zip) and monthly new-licence PDFs.

local_control: Yes - retail liquor licences are issued by counties and incorporated cities (Clark County, Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Washoe County, Reno, Sparks, etc.).
alternatives: Clark County Business License Search https://www.clarkcountynv.gov/business/doing_business_with_clark_county/business-license-search (filter liquor categories)
Clark County monthly business-licence PDFs
City of Las Vegas open data portal (ArcGIS) - no liquor dataset seen
Washoe County open data (opendata.washoecounty.gov) - no liquor dataset seen
Southern Nevada Health District / Washoe health food permit lists
Public records requests (NRS 239) to each county/city business licence office
manual_steps: Submit NRS 239 public records requests to Clark County Business License (702-455-4340), City of Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Washoe County, Reno, Sparks for active liquor licence lists
Or export category searches from Clark County Business License Search
notes: Fragmented local licensing; Clark + Washoe cover most of the market. Many casino-resort outlets operate under a single resort licence, so Places enrichment is essential.

sources.title: Washoe County Liquor and Gaming Licenses
City of Las Vegas Alcohol License Information

name: New Hampshire
agency: New Hampshire Liquor Commission (NHLC), Division of Enforcement & Licensing

licence_data.on_premise_codes: On-premise licence types include restaurant, cocktail lounge, hotel, club, etc. (see NHLC licensing resources); not confirmed in a data file.
licence_data.terms_notes: No public licensee list or search found. ~2,163 on-premise licensees per NHLC Licensee Information Handbook (July 2025).

local_control: State issues; local governing body approval required.
alternatives: RSA 91-A Right-to-Know request to RightToKnow@liquor.nh.gov
Ask Licensing Unit licensing@liquor.nh.gov / lic.geninfo@liquor.nh.gov
NH town health/food service licence lists
manual_steps: Email RightToKnow@liquor.nh.gov (or write 50 Storrs St, Concord NH 03301) requesting an electronic list of all active on-premise licensees with licence type, DBA and address; repeat periodically
notes: Control state: state runs all retail spirits/wine stores (NH Liquor & Wine Outlets). Small state - one request covers everything.

sources.title: NHLC On-Premise & Off-Premise Licensee Information handbook

name: New Jersey
agency: NJ Division of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC), Office of the Attorney General

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Licence type in licence number: 33 = Plenary Retail Consumption (bars/restaurants), 31 = Club, 32 = Seasonal Retail Consumption, 36 = Hotel/Motel; 44 = Plenary Retail Distribution (liquor store, off-premise).
licence_data.terms_notes: Retail Licensee Listing xlsx; file name changes each release (e.g. Retail_Licensee-2025-0304.xlsx, 2024-12_Retail-License-Listing_Report.xlsx); latest seen dated 4/1/26.

local_control: Retail consumption/distribution licences are issued by municipalities (ABC boards / governing bodies); state compiles the statewide listing.
alternatives: Individual municipal clerk licence lists
POSSE ABC public licence search
manual_steps: Periodically open the Licensing Reports page and download the latest 'Retail Licensee Listing (.xlsx)' (URL changes each release; could be automated by scraping the page for the .xlsx link)
notes: Some dry towns (e.g. Ocean City, Haddonfield historically). Releases appear roughly monthly-to-quarterly. No geocoding.

name: New Mexico
agency: NM Regulation and Licensing Department, Alcoholic Beverage Control Division (ABC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Dispenser licence (full liquor; note dispensers can also be package stores), Restaurant licence (beer & wine; newer restaurant licences may add spirits), Club licence.
licence_data.terms_notes: Salesforce (NM-PLUS) public search; no bulk export seen.

local_control: State issues; local option districts and local governing body approval.
alternatives: IPRA public records request to RLD for an export of active liquor licences
Albuquerque/Bernalillo County open data or food inspection lists
NM Environment Dept food permits
manual_steps: Submit an IPRA request to NM RLD (ABC Division, 505-476-4875) for all active liquor licences with type and premises address
Or scrape the NM-PLUS public search
notes: Dispenser licences mix bars and package stores; filter via Places. Tribal lands/pueblos have their own rules.

name: North Carolina
agency: North Carolina Alcoholic Beverage Control Commission (NC ABCC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Retail permit types: on-premises malt beverage, on-premises unfortified/fortified wine, mixed beverages (restaurant, hotel, private club, etc.); off-premises permits for grocery/convenience.
licence_data.terms_notes: Permit Counts page downloads Excel counts by county only (not licensee rows).

local_control: State ABCC issues retail permits; spirits retail via ~170 local ABC boards (county/city); mixed-beverage sales require local election approval.
alternatives: Public records request to NC ABCC (Contact@abc.nc.gov) for full permittee export
County/city ABC board lists
NC county health dept restaurant inspection data (e.g. Wake County open data)
manual_steps: Email Contact@abc.nc.gov / file a public records request for all active retail on-premise permits with DBA and address
notes: Control state with local ABC boards. Some dry/partially wet counties. Mixed beverage permit is the key bar/restaurant signal.

name: North Dakota
agency: North Dakota Attorney General, Licensing Section

licence_data.on_premise_codes: State licence type codes shown in PDF (license list lists number, business, address by city/county, expiry); type meanings not confirmed - local licence class determines on/off sale.
licence_data.terms_notes: PDF report (e.g. uploads/2026/04/Licensees-AlcoholicBeverage.pdf, report run 08/25/2026) - URL path changes on re-upload.

local_control: Dual licensing: state AG licence plus a local licence from the city (or county commissioners outside cities, or tribal government); local licence class defines on-sale vs off-sale.
alternatives: City licence lists (Fargo, Bismarck, Grand Forks, Minot)
ND tax dept
manual_steps: Download the current alcoholic beverage licensee PDF from the AG License Holders page and parse it (pdf-to-table); repeat periodically
notes: PDF parsing required; on/off-premise distinction not clear at state level, rely on Places type.

name: Ohio
agency: Ohio Department of Commerce, Division of Liquor Control (DOLC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Permit classes: D-1 (beer on-premise), D-2 (wine/mixed bev on-premise), D-3 (spirits on-premise), D-5 (full on-premise night club/restaurant), D-5a..D-5l special variants, D-6 (Sunday); C-1/C-2 off-premise.
licence_data.terms_notes: Permit Lookup results grid can be saved as Excel/CSV via icons; update frequency assumed live (unconfirmed). No data.ohio.gov dataset found.

local_control: State issues permits; local option elections (precinct-level wet/dry) and local objection rights.
alternatives: OPAL (opal.ohio.gov) reports
Public records request to DOLC for full permit export
manual_steps: Run Permit Holder lookup by county (88 counties) and export CSV/Excel via grid icons; or request bulk export from DOLC
notes: Control state for spirits (agency liquor stores). Many precincts dry. Filter D-class permits for bars/restaurants.

name: Oklahoma
agency: Oklahoma Alcoholic Beverage Laws Enforcement (ABLE) Commission

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Mixed Beverage licence (bars/restaurants), Beer & Wine licence, Caterer, Bottle Club, Public Event; Mixed Beverage Licensee List published separately.
licence_data.terms_notes: File format of the Mixed Beverage Licensee List not confirmed (page last modified Aug 2026).

local_control: State issues; city/county also issue local alcoholic beverage licences (e.g. City of OKC); mixed-beverage sales require county election approval.
alternatives: ABLE Licensee Search https://oklahoma.gov/able-commission/enforcement/licensee-search.html
Open records request via ABLE Smartsheet form (ABLE_Legal@able.ok.gov)
City of OKC/Tulsa business licence lists
manual_steps: Periodically download the Mixed Beverage (and Beer & Wine) Licensee List from the 'Listing of Licensees by License Type' page (confirm format)
notes: A few counties still disallow mixed beverage sales. Tribal casinos licensed separately.

sources.title: Listing of Licensees by License Type

name: Oregon

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Full On-Premises (commercial, caterer, public passenger carrier, other public location, for-profit/non-profit private club) and Limited On-Premises licence types; Off-Premises = retail stores.
licence_data.terms_notes: Socrata SODA API; columns and geocoding not verified via search. Related: OLCC Liquor Applications Received qad4-bnxp, Non-Renewals mhc6-qsxj.

alternatives: OLCC Liquor Applications Received (data.oregon.gov qad4-bnxp) for new openings
notes: Best in this batch - direct CO/NY-style Socrata pull. Control state (state-run liquor agency stores).

name: Pennsylvania

licence_data.on_premise_codes: R = Restaurant (liquor), H = Hotel, E = Eating Place (malt only), C/CC = Club/Catering Club, PR/ airport etc.; D = beer distributor (off-premise).
licence_data.terms_notes: PLCB+ License Search / Data Export: search shows max 200 rows, but a full CSV export of all active licences is offered.

local_control: State issues; municipal quota by county population and local option referenda.
alternatives: PLCB+ search by municipality
manual_steps: Open PLCB+ License Search / Data Export and download the full active-licences CSV periodically (POSSE page - may be scriptable with a headless browser)
notes: Control state (Fine Wine & Good Spirits stores). Some dry municipalities.
